name: Babylonia
line: Babylonia was the land where Israel's exiles lived and where the temple treasures were kept, and from it God's people returned to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Temple articles go home
moments.text: Sheshbazzar brought 5,400 gold and silver articles along when the exiles went up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

moments.title: Darius orders a search
moments.text: King Darius ordered a search of the archives in the treasury of Babylon. A scroll was found with Cyrus's decree to rebuild God's house.

moments.title: Ezra leaves Babylon
moments.text: Ezra, a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, began the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month. He reached Jerusalem in the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.

moments.title: Gifts from Babylon
moments.text: King Artaxerxes told Ezra to take the silver and gold he might find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offerings, to the house of God in Jerusalem.

moments.title: Family heads return
moments.text: Ezra listed the family heads and records of those who returned with him from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes.
